decisive_items: a destructive lesion centered on the anterior wall of the right maxillary sinus, forming a large soft-tissue mass
response.rationale: Rhabdomyosarcoma is more likely due to the presence of a rapidly enlarging, destructive lesion with heterogeneous enhancement and invasion into surrounding structures, which is suggestive of a malignant tumor

rejected.why: Langerhans cell histiocytosis is a rare neoplastic disorder, but the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with a malignant tumor like rhabdomyosarcoma
Orbital cellulitis is unlikely due to the lack of response to antibiotic treatment and the presence of a destructive lesion on imaging, which suggests an alternative diagnosis
